description: Microi吾码企业应用版 12 张具体业务 AI 界面概念图的策划 brief 与内置 image_gen 提示词。画面为 AI 生成的产品设计概念，不是实际客户或系统截图。
sharedArtDirection: 专业 SaaS 产品界面概念图；4:3 横幅，前方具体业务系统界面与后方 Microi吾码表单/模块/流程框架界面构成两窗层次。5–10 度浅透视，深蓝品牌壳子、浅色业务区、蓝绿状态。完整保留屏幕边缘，核心内容清晰；图片使用 contain，不裁切界面窗口。实际工具提示词以 basePrompt 和每页 prompt 为准。

brief.businessGoal: 一眼理解平台能够承载日常企业经营和 AI 应用。
brief.mainScreen: 吾码企业工作台：左导航、应用入口区与待办列表；主内容有订单、客户、审批三类应用入口，右侧 AI 助手针对待办提供一句简短建议。
brief.secondaryScreens: 侧后方一个小型手机工作台预览，显示相同待办。
brief.composition: 一张宽幅主工作台占绝大部分，右后方手机仅作多端提示，不让手机抢主画面。
brief.sourceBoundaries: 平台方向示意，不表示某个客户的正式运行系统。

images.prompt:
Create a polished product explainer illustration for Microi吾码 enterprise software. Category: high-fidelity ui-mockup, generated concept interfaces, NOT a real screenshot. Landscape 4:3 composition. The image is dominated by TWO clearly designed desktop software UI windows: a large front business application window and a slightly offset rear Microi low-code framework window. Subtle 3D perspective only (5–10 degrees), layered solid panels, credible browser chrome, soft shadows, blue edge light, natural screen typography; flat readable contents on the screens. Real product design, not sci-fi fantasy. Consistent Microi platform shell: dark navy top bar with exact short brand “Microi吾码”, pale blue-white work area, slim sidebar with simple icons, a few compact tabs, tidy cards and table rows, accent cyan/blue/green. Front UI should show the specific business workflow below using a FEW large, legible Chinese labels, recognisable controls, realistic charts/tables, and coherent hierarchy. Rear framework UI visibly suggests form/module/approval building in Microi with exact short labels “表单”, “模块”, “流程” where appropriate. Compose two UI windows plus at most one small AI helper card; no huge paragraph, no standalone title/slogan floating outside screens. Deep ink-blue studio background with restrained technical grid, no cosmic nebula, no glowing brain/orb, no robots, no floating factories, no generic city skyline, no abstract particle streams. Keep the key application interface centered, with generous margins so complete window edges fit a 4:3 figure. Business UI is the hero, 3D depth supports it. All data is an illustrative mockup; if numbers appear use small ordinary example figures rather than impressive performance or ROI claims. Do not present customer logos, proprietary company names or certified achievement badges. Output one complete illustration, not a multi-image collage/contact sheet. Scene-specific content:
Enterprise application overview: front screen “企业工作台” shows three large modules labelled “客户”, “订单”, “审批”, a compact worklist, and a small weekly progress chart. A small integrated assistant card “AI 助手” offers one short action “生成应用”. Rear Microi framework screen shows a simple visual form builder with three tidy input fields and a right property sidebar, conveying how an idea becomes a working enterprise app. Two UI screens feel like a coherent software product family, not science-fiction holograms.
images.disclosure: AI 界面概念图，非真实系统或客户截图

brief.businessGoal: 体现看得见客户订单、协同进度和经营异常。
brief.mainScreen: 经营驾驶舱：横向订单趋势图、客户与订单状态表、项目进度条；右侧异常列表和待审批队列；关键状态使用蓝绿与少量橙色，图表清晰但不展示收益数字。
brief.secondaryScreens: 一个小型 AI 分析面板连接趋势图，指向异常定位与办理入口。
brief.composition: 主 dashboard 近乎正视、小角度透视；图表、状态表和待办同屏各有明确空间。
brief.sourceBoundaries: 全部为界面与图形样例，不创造 ROI 或客户运营结果。

brief.businessGoal: 用明确的软件界面说明统一平台可组合 ERP、CRM、OA 等产品。
brief.mainScreen: 统一吾码框架中一个 ERP 订单表为主屏，表头简洁，具有采购/库存/订单状态；旁边两个较小的同风格界面分别是 CRM 商机看板和 OA 审批列表。
brief.secondaryScreens: CRM 为三列销售阶段看板，OA 为简洁审批列表；三屏共用同一品牌与导航语言。
brief.composition: 三张真实感 SaaS 面板错层排列，中心 ERP 大于两侧界面，层次浅、内容清楚，不做九宫格。
brief.sourceBoundaries: 产品方向组合，不能标为已交付某客户的一体化系统。

brief.businessGoal: 把服装行业规则表现成订单、尺码和工序业务界面。
brief.mainScreen: 服装 ERP 订单生产页：主屏有订单状态、动态尺码矩阵（S/M/L）、裁床分包表和工序进度；侧边短标签区分裁剪与缝制进度。
brief.secondaryScreens: 一个手机界面展示菲票明细列表，保留款号、尺码、数量与对应裁床分包记录；不展示扫码或登记动作。
brief.composition: 主尺码表与分包清单占画面中心，手机在右下方浅层叠放，保持字号清楚。
brief.sourceBoundaries: 仅概念化呈现公开案例描述的动态尺码、裁床分包、菲票明细与移动端能力；不扩写扫码交付事实。不是客户实拍或其真实系统 UI，不绘制客户品牌或收益。

revisions.prompt: Edit only the small smartphone screen in this Microi enterprise ERP concept illustration. Preserve the two large PC software windows, their garment order/size matrix/cutting bundle tables, all UI positions, 3D perspective, blue/navy colors, window borders, reflections and canvas size. On the smartphone replace the heading “菲票扫码” with the exact short text “菲票明细”. Remove the scan rectangle, scanning beam and all barcode/scan instructions. Replace that upper dark scanning area with a clean pale-blue/white mobile ticket-detail list: two garment thumbnails with short rows for ticket number, style, size and quantity, consistent with the existing lower ticket list. Use a small filter row and “查看详情” controls. The phone should demonstrate MOBILE TICKET VIEWING, with NO scanner, barcode, QR code or workflow registration. Do not add any extra device, title, slogan or new functionality. Keep the full image professional, sharp, and consistent with the existing Microi吾码 framework interface.

Make ONE tiny text correction in the smartphone of this illustration. In the smartphone list section, replace the small heading currently reading “最近扫描 (2)” / “最近扫码 (2)” with the exact text “菲票列表 (2)”. There must be no 扫码, 扫描, scanner, barcode or QR label anywhere in that phone. Preserve the already-correct main phone title “菲票明细”, both garment ticket cards, their 查看详情 links and all other pixels/design as closely as possible. The two large PC windows and the complete 3D composition must remain unchanged. This phone is ONLY a garment ticket list/viewing screen.

brief.businessGoal: 体现已有系统连接、跨库报表与移动审批。
brief.mainScreen: 集团协同工作台：左部已有系统连接列表与清晰连接状态，中间跨部门经营报表，右部待办和飞书协作入口；导航保留统一吾码壳子。
brief.secondaryScreens: 手机 OA 审批页，显示审批步骤与通过/退回动作；它与制造协同主屏是不同公开案例能力的概念组合。
brief.composition: 一个主工作台加一个手机审批界面，以浅透视体现连接与协作，不画工厂建筑或系统能量节点。
brief.sourceBoundaries: 不把两条公开案例合成同一客户的实际交付；不写 11 以外的系统数量或编造效益。

brief.businessGoal: 说明客户管理和对客服务能够在 PC 与移动端协同。
brief.mainScreen: CRM 客户服务页：客户列表与销售阶段小看板、最近跟进记录；右侧辅助窗口呈现房源地图、房源卡片和预约动作。
brief.secondaryScreens: 手机房源详情页包含隐私联系和 VR 看房入口，不画真实电话号码或地址。
brief.composition: 主 CRM 占画面中心，地图窗口与手机在右侧浅叠，不把画面变成房屋渲染图。
brief.sourceBoundaries: CRM 与房地产公开案例能力的概念组合，不宣称它们来自同一个客户。

brief.businessGoal: 用一屏清晰说明 AI 从查事实到人工确认后办理的闭环。
brief.mainScreen: 客户跟进 Agent 工作台：左侧客户事实与来源，中央短建议和待办草稿，右侧人工确认区，底部记录执行状态；状态串联为读取事实、生成草稿、人工确认、记录结果。
brief.secondaryScreens: 一个小型任务记录浮层，显示确认后进入待办与完成记录；不让聊天气泡占满画面。
brief.composition: 主体是业务处理界面，四个阶段形成清晰阅读方向，人工确认区以绿色强调。
brief.sourceBoundaries: 按 PPT 现有设计示例呈现，不表示平台默认配置即可自动执行全部业务。

brief.businessGoal: 用搭建界面体现成熟能力复用、规则扩展和多端交付。
brief.mainScreen: 低代码表单设计器：左侧少量控件组件、中央整洁表单预览、右侧字段/权限配置；上方有审批与报表的简短模块入口。
brief.secondaryScreens: 小型 PC 与手机预览界面呈现同一表单，旁边一条简洁审批流程连线。
brief.composition: 设计器大屏居中，两个辅助预览尺寸小而完整，组件图标清楚，不堆代码与技术列表。
brief.sourceBoundaries: 平台设计能力概念；不要伪造截图或加入未证实的平台内置功能。
